{{Top|leg}}
'''D/Crypt Information Services''' provided slicing and other data-retrieval services throughout [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Based out of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], just prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], used the service to locate [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] and hack its data banks.
